reason: The original is it.skip on WebKit, and a path option is needsFeature on the other browsers (see the next entry)

Strider has no addScriptTag. These assert what the call returns or raises: a handle (AT-002, AT-007, AT-009), the error for a missing options object (AT-001), for a failed load (AT-006, AT-012 with the URL in its message), or for a CSP block (AT-010, AT-011). A tag inserted in the main world has no handle, and its errors are not the call's. AT-003 and AT-005 add a module script by URL and by content: a tag the test inserts itself in the main world would test only the browser's module loading, not Strider
addScriptTag's path option, which reads a file and inserts its content with a sourceURL; Strider has no such option, and inserting the file's text from the test would test the test's own file read
